Unmanaged Model
LED Indicators
P(Power Status) / Green Indicator	On: power status is normal	Off: power off or power connection failure
S(System Status) / Red Indicator	Non-PoE Models	PoE Models
S(System Status) / Red Indicator	On: the chip read/write is abnormal / Off: the chip is normally operating	On: PoE usage≥90% rated budget
S(System Status) / Red Indicator	On: the chip read/write is abnormal / Off: the chip is normally operating	Blinking: 50%<PoE usage<90% rated budget
S(System Status) / Red Indicator	On: the chip read/write is abnormal / Off: the chip is normally operating	Off: PoE usage<50% rated budget
Ethernet Port Status / Green Indicator	On: port link up
Ethernet Port Status / Green Indicator	Blinking: data is in normal transmission
Ethernet Port Status / Green Indicator	Off: port link down
Ethernet Port Status / PoE Status / Yellow Indicator	Non-PoE Models	PoE Models
Ethernet Port Status / PoE Status / Yellow Indicator	1000M models	10/100M models	On: PoE working / Off: PoE not working
Ethernet Port Status / PoE Status / Yellow Indicator	On: port speed is 1000M	On: port speed is 100M	On: PoE working / Off: PoE not working
Ethernet Port Status / PoE Status / Yellow Indicator	Off: port speed is 10/100M	Off: ports on 10M	On: PoE working / Off: PoE not working
Fiber Port Status / Green Indicator	On: port link up
Fiber Port Status / Green Indicator	Blinking: data is in normal transmission
Fiber Port Status / Green Indicator	Off: port link down
Please refer to the datasheet or take with us for more information
Managed Model
LED Indicators
P(Power Status) / Green Indicator	On: power status is normal	Off: power off or power connection failure
S(System Status) / Green Indicator	On: Normal operation / Blinking: Device initialization / Off: Connection failure
USB(USB status) / Green Indicator	On: USB flash drive is detected by device / Blinking: the device is reading and writing the data from USB flash drive / Off: USB flash drive not insert or not detected by device
ALM(Fault Status) / Red Indicator	Off: Device on normal working state	On: Fault alarm
Ring(Ring Network)	Off: Ring network disable	On: Ring network enable
Ethernet Port Status / Green Indicator	On: port link up
Ethernet Port Status / Green Indicator	Blinking: data is in normal transmission
Ethernet Port Status / Green Indicator	Off: port link down
Ethernet Port Status / PoE Status / Yellow Indicator	Non-PoE Models	PoE Models
Ethernet Port Status / PoE Status / Yellow Indicator	1000M models	10/100M models	On: PoE working / Off: PoE not working
Ethernet Port Status / PoE Status / Yellow Indicator	On: port speed is 1000M	On: port speed is 100M	On: PoE working / Off: PoE not working
Ethernet Port Status / PoE Status / Yellow Indicator	Off: port speed is 10/100M	Off: ports on 10M	On: PoE working / Off: PoE not working
Fiber Port Status / Green Indicator	On: port link up
Fiber Port Status / Green Indicator	Blinking: data is in normal transmission
Fiber Port Status / Green Indicator	Off: port link down
Connector Definition
RS485	A	Data positive line
RS485	B	Data negative line
G	G	Grounding line
DI	+	Digital input +(“1”: None or -30~+1V) / Max input current: 8mA
DI	-	Digital input-(“0”: +12V~+30V)
Relay		Normally open
Relay		Normally close
